commit.message:
ref(derived_code_mappings): Report error when API response is not empty (#46186)

Getting repositories sometimes may be empty even if the count of
repositories is greater than 0.

This change reduces the number of reported errors to when there's at
least a single repository.

This fixes [SENTRY-YKB](https://sentry.sentry.io/issues/3915004865) just
because a new error will be produced with a subset of all errors.
